definitions.meaning: a longbow or crossbow as defined in the Wildlife Act
definitions.quote: “Bow” means a longbow or crossbow as defined in the Wildlife Act;

definitions.meaning: a gun, shotgun, pistol, air pistol, air gun, air rifle, pellet gun, spring gun, or any other weapon from which any shot, bullet or other projectile can be discharged, except a starting pistol at an athletic event with blank ammunition
definitions.quote: "Firearm” means a gun, shotgun, pistol, air pistol, air gun, air rifle, pellet gun, spring gun, or any other weapon from which any shot, bullet or other projectile can be discharged

prohibitions.where: any part of the City shown on Schedule "A" as "closed to the discharge of firearms"
prohibitions.quote: No person shall discharge a firearm or Bow within any part of the City that is shown on Schedule “A” of this bylaw as "closed to the discharge of firearms".

exceptions.quote: a person engaged in a farm operation who discharges a firearm for the purpose of protecting crops or livestock from injury or destruction by animals or birds
a person engaged in the slaughter of livestock, where such livestock is legally kept

a peace officer, a conservation officer, or an employee of the City, the Government of British Columbia, the Government of Canada or the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals, who discharges a firearm in the lawful performance of that person’s duties

exceptions.permit: authorized sporting event under a sports governing body
exceptions.quote: the use of a firearm or bow where the use is part of an authorized sporting event under the supervision of a local, national or international sports governing body
the lawful operation of a shooting or target range

exceptions.permit: prior permission of the land owner
exceptions.quote: the use of a Bow on private land when the person using the Bow has received the prior permission of the owner of said land and the Bow is used to shoot an arrow or other projectile at a stationary inanimate target

schedule_maps.name: Schedule "A"
schedule_maps.description: Areas of the City closed to the discharge of firearms
